prompt.project_info: Ultra-photorealistic vertical medium close-up selfie of an original adult woman in a warm minimal home environment, with authentic candid western-inspired styling.
prompt.main_subject: One original adult woman with fair skin and soft pink undertones, oval face, soft jawline, light expressive eyes, natural pink lips and softly flushed cheeks. She has a big joyful tooth-showing smile with eyes tightly squinted, conveying playful carefree happiness. Her light golden-blonde hair is just below the shoulders, slightly wavy, center-parted and softly framing the face. She wears a cream felt cowboy hat, a light beige or cream soft cotton/linen sleeveless blouse with a feminine slightly fitted shape, a softly pink lace bralette subtly visible beneath the blouse, and a white bandana with small black paisley print loosely tied at the front. Do not reproduce Sydney Sweeney or any other public-figure likeness.
prompt.composition_elements: Use a close selfie angle slightly above chest level, medium close-up vertical crop, head slightly tilted, relaxed and leaning into frame. Keep sharp focus on face and upper body with a softly blurred neutral minimal home background. Preserve the spontaneous selfie moment and natural expression.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft warm natural indoor side light with low contrast, cozy authentic atmosphere and realistic skin texture. Avoid dramatic studio lighting and preserve true-to-life color.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-photorealistic vertical selfie, smartphone perspective, medium close-up, shallow depth of field, realistic hat felt, cotton, linen, lace and skin texture, natural color accuracy, no text, logo or watermark.
